snippet_primary: "As a new seller, I failed to manually update the tracking numbers for two Printify T-shirt orders. I genuinely believed they would sync automatically, as they had with my candle orders. I now understand that it was my responsibility. These orders were shipped on time by Printify, but I believe my failure to update the tracking contributed to the suspension. This was never an attempt to ignore Etsy's policies. I was doing my best, but I made a mistake due to my inexperience. Since the suspension, I've submitted four appeals and sent multiple emails, but I haven't received a clear explanation or the opportunity to speak with someone directly."
